title: Night Force #14 DC September 1983 Final Issue Marv Wolfman Gene Colan Horror
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned with light wear at the lower left. See photos.
descriptionText:
Night Force #14 (September 1983), DC Comics - final "fear-fraught" issue of the series. Written by Marv Wolfman, art by Gene Colan. Baron Winters. Superman III movie sweepstakes inside. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: Mattel Intellivision Advanced Dungeons & Dragons cartridge ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; back cover lightly toned with light wear at the lower left (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
